description: News for a Gyptian fleet that says it has found the road home.

start: {faction} says it has read the next gate in the Reckoning of the Road, and is gathering at {system} to follow it. Gate wardens have been asked for comment. They have not given any.
Gyptian families are arriving at {system} from all over. {faction} says the road home is open. Scholars say it says that every so often.
{faction} has announced a departure from {system} 'towards Gyptian'. The port authority has asked them to pay their berthing fees first.
ongoing: {system} is full of Gyptian ships and running short of stores. The singing can be heard on three decks.
Concord observers at {system} describe the Gyptian gathering as 'a festival with a navigation problem'.
A Synod preacher at {system} is asking the Gyptians for a copy of their Reckoning. They have politely refused.
end: {faction} has left {system}. The gate they meant to take did not open for them. They say it was not yet time.
The Gyptian gathering at {system} has broken up. Most families went home. Some say they are home, wherever the fleet is.
{faction} says it has recorded the gate and will try again. Nobody at {system} is quite sure what was tried.
